exposure: younger fetal gestational age at diagnosis
Pulmonary complications during the peripartum period
cohort: 126 women diagnosed with pulmonary complications during pregnancy (N = 79) and peripartum within the first 4 weeks after delivery (N = 47)
finding: Pulmonary complications during pregnancy and the peripartum period were associated with poor outcomes, including a high risk of adverse fetal outcomes, particularly in patients with pregnancy-related complications and younger gestational age at the diagnosis.
mod_finding: Women with pulmonary complications during pregnancy and the peripartum period had a higher rate of emergency C-sections (26.6%).
